newsitem.title: UK: Ruberoid results to be below expectation.
newsitem.headline: Ruberoid results to be below expectation.

text.p: Coatings and waterproofing systems group Ruberoid Plc said on Thursday that its results for the full year were likely to be below expectation after a disappointing second half.
But the company said that in the absence of any unforeseen circumstances, the total dividend payment would be maintained at 6.1 pence per share.
The outlook for the coming year was much more positive thanks to good order books and an expected upturn in the market, said Ruberoid chief executive Ian Mcpherson.
Trading in the closing weeks of 1996 has been affected by particularly unfavourable weather in continental Europe during November and by adverse currency translation.
The UK and U.S. performance had, however, remained on target with market share and margins being maintained, the company said.
Ruberoid also said it had appointed Bryan Stock as finance director with effect from January 1 succeeding David Watson who isd retiring.
Stock was previously finance director for Polypipe Plc.
Ruberoid also said it was to withdraw from contracting operations in France with the sale of its subsidiary Tocover SA.
